_source: Vision's own quote to IQ, by email, 22 September 2026. Euros, excluding VAT.
Vision invoice from Italy, so euros is what they will actually bill.
One price per model: a freehub does not change what a wheelset costs, so
all three of them take their model's figure.
These are here rather than read out of the Shopify export because the
export is in sterling, at an old rate. Every price in it is 0.8550 of the
quote to four places — one conversion applied to the whole file on one
day, not a discount, which would have landed on some lines and not
others. The euro figures are what Vision charges; the sterling ones are
worked out from them at a rate we choose, by rebuild.mjs --fx.
rebuild.mjs reports the gap on every run rather than quietly preferring
